The auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk (65% low-confidence keypoints), particularly in the hind limbs and face of the secondary birds. While the central bird looks good, the flanking birds show significant anatomical ambiguity (fusion of legs/body, indistinct heads) which the Router only partially captured in the 'leftmost bird' observation. The `topology_boundary_auditor` mask shows fragmentation in the background/secondary subjects, supporting the presence of structural defects in the non-primary subjects. Therefore, the artifact severity should be adjusted upward to reflect these widespread minor-to-moderate structural weaknesses in the secondary subjects.
